name: superpowers-automation
description: Packages two PostToolUse Write hooks from the superpowers workflow as individually-toggled options, with an optional advisor review gate. All features default off. A configure skill provides an interactive wizard.

hook_plans.title: Plans hook
hook_plans.description: Values: true = inject 'Use approach: 1. Subagent-Driven.' when writing docs/superpowers/plans/*.md; false = no injection. Default: false.

hook_specs.title: Specs hook
hook_specs.description: Values: true = inject 'User has reviewed and confirmed the spec. Proceed after self-review.' when writing docs/superpowers/specs/*.md; false = no injection. Default: false.

hook_advisor_review.title: Advisor review gate
hook_advisor_review.description: Values: true = append advisor() gate instruction to any active hook's injected message; false = no gate. Applies to both hooks when enabled. Default: false.
